procedure: Two independent read-only verifiers per owner §4. Neither is the codex judge panel (no holdout exposure to qualification models).

verifierB_definitions.identity: independent Claude subagent (opus-4-8), applied ONLY the written definitions
verifierB_definitions.result: 14/14 MATCH, 0 MISMATCH on the original holdout(8)+calibration(6); explicitly confirmed the UNSUPPORTED(U2) vs INCONCLUSIVE(I1/I2) boundary is drawn correctly (unbacked assertion vs named-missing-comparator)

verifierA_adversarial.identity: inline adversarial pass (this agent), maximal skepticism, tried to construct a defensible alternative for every label
verifierA_adversarial.result: 7 of 8 holdout AGREE + all 6 calibration AGREE; SQV3-RF-P2 FLAGGED CONTESTED (PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED vs UNSUPPORTED — 'completely broken/unusable' over a correct-key quiz with one duplicate distractor is the RF6-class severity ambiguity) → BLOCKED and REPLACED per 'any disagreement blocks the case'

p2Replacement.from: single-question quiz, correct key + duplicate distractor (severity-overstatement, contestable)
p2Replacement.to: three-question quiz where Q1/Q2 keys match their explanations and Q3 key contradicts its explanation; finding claims 'ALL THREE wrong / entire quiz broken' → exactly one real key defect + scope overstatement → unambiguous PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED
p2Replacement.deterministicCheck: 1/3 keys contradict their own explanation (mechanically verifiable, model-independent)

finalVerdict: all 8 fresh holdout + 6 calibration labels AGREE across both verifier roles after the P2 replacement; corpus sealed on this basis
